title: 第13章 野兽派第14章 角色扮演
content_zh:
第十三章 野兽派
终于要在正式比赛中登场了，望着观众席上人山人海，叶锋深吸了几口气。
这么多人看着，如果发挥不好，也许这群人都会到网上发帖说湖人不该签我，我必须用行动证明自己可以打NBA。叶锋正想着，忽然后背一疼，被人狠狠的拍了一巴掌。
费舍尔看出他的异样，才给了他一巴掌，大声说道：“你别紧张！回忆一下这些天学的东西，训练的时候怎么做现在就怎么做。你在训练的时候防守的可是科比，奥多姆。勇士队的这些人算什么？你防的住他们。”
费舍尔总是很照顾叶锋，说些鼓励的话，叶锋感激的点了点头，走上场去。
双方都调整了阵容，换上了几名替补。勇士大前锋位置上换上了布兰登.赖特。赖特是今年的新秀，首轮第八顺位被山猫队选中。叶锋一站在他身边，就感觉他是个怪胎，这家伙的胳膊太长了！
赖特面无表情，看起来就像个呆头鹅。他身高206CM，臂展却达到了223CM，比叶锋胳膊还长一截，不过他的体重只有91公斤。山猫就是拿他做筹码换走了勇士的理查德森，勇士队很看好他的发展潜力。
叶锋鼓足了力气，这是个好机会。他记得前世赖特没什么了不起的，水货一个。如今联盟里可没人知道这一点，只要战胜赖特，他的评价肯定会提高。
湖人进攻，法玛尔带球到了前场，拜纳姆拉到了高位负责掩护，他的中投比叶锋准的多，叶锋则跑位准备空切和拼抢进攻篮板。赖特的速度也很快，是大个子中比较惊人的，跟上了叶锋。
只要叶锋身边有人跟着，后卫就不会把球传到他手中，他的单打能力根本不值得信任。
法玛尔在三秒区边缘突分给了拉德马诺维奇，后者又快速将球转移到了底脚的武贾西奇。武贾西奇接球就三分出手，球弹框而出。
赖特上肢力量很差，84公斤卧推才能推两次，被叶锋卡在了身后，但得分后卫皮特鲁斯对篮板球位置的判断非常准确，冲抢下了篮板，叶锋赶忙回防。
速度是勇士队制胜的唯一法宝，皮特鲁斯拿下篮板就往前传发动快攻，根本不等内线球员落位。戴维斯下场后，蒙塔.埃利斯就是球队的第一主攻点，球传到了他的手上，他拿球就就往湖人半场冲去，轻松甩开了法玛尔。
就当埃利斯急停准备跳投的时候，叶锋从后面跳了起来，空中滑翔着扑了过去，埃利斯的反应很快，投篮改为了虚晃，看着叶锋从自己身边飞过，不过他再想投篮的时候已经失去机会，法玛尔回防到位了。
叶锋刚才在对方篮下，回防却比先跑的拜纳姆快的多，几步就过了半场，刚才从起跳到落地的距离，足够从罚球线跳到篮下去，这一下是补防成功了！
有人发现了这一点，巴克利惊讶道：“我的天，他刚刚飞了多远？”
史密斯笑道：“果然是恐怖的素质。”
赖特也跑到篮下了，叶锋上前贴身防守，把他挡在三秒区外。埃利斯控球传给了外线的巴恩斯，出了外线找掩护，赖特上前挡拆帮助埃利斯拿球，叶锋换防后又和埃利斯对位了。
埃利斯2005年第二轮总第40顺位被金州勇士队选中，是NBA末代高中生中的一员。他的突破速度惊人，能在长人如林的禁区肆意穿梭，得分如砍瓜切菜。到这个赛季，他已经开始展现实力了。
很少有内线球员能够在挡拆换防后跟上他的速度，但叶锋就是例外，他绕开赖特，一步挡在了埃利斯的突破路线上，让他没能顺利冲入三秒区。

又是这个家伙，好快的速度！埃利斯左肩轻晃，带球迅速向右侧变向。叶锋没有吃假动作，又挡住了他的行进路线。这样的变向假动作，他被科比过了不知多少遍，防守起来已经有了经验，他不只观察肩膀的移动，还用眼的余光注意埃利斯要迈哪条腿。
上赛季埃利斯获得进步最快球员奖，信心已经打出来了，他怎么能忍受被一个橄榄球运动员防住，立即后撤步带球，右脚为轴，右手做出了背后运球的动作，做到一半，右手将球交左手**运球，再由左手**运球交回右手。
连续两次跨下把叶锋晃晕了，他的身体微微右移，埃利斯立即迈出一大步，从叶锋左侧突破了。
叶锋一吃假动作就知道要被过，他在布莱恩.肖的指导下已经清楚了补救的办法，他将错就错，没有丝毫停顿，从右侧顺势转身追击上篮的埃利斯。
埃利斯右手单手拿球准备上篮的时候，用眼的余光瞥见了提前跳起封盖的叶锋，他可不是吃素的，知道没甩开，跳起来后在空中右手缩回做了一个拉杆动作再上篮，企图躲开叶锋的封盖。
埃利斯失算了，叶锋好像定在空中一般迟迟不落下，张开右手打乱了他的投篮节奏，他将球从叶锋身边低手送了出去，在篮筐上转了一圈偏出。沃顿拿下了篮板球。
叶锋落地后立即向勇士半场冲去，直接参与快攻了。
这家伙还是人吗？赖特在勇士内线球员中是最快的，可他却被叶锋甩在了身后。法玛尔的球直塞到了叶锋的手里。叶锋中路拿球，面前防守的人是巴恩斯。
叶锋带球还是很烂，他没有信心过任何人，而且一旦带上球，速度优势也发挥不出来了。平时加练的时候，他除了带球和投篮，练习最多的是扣篮，扣篮是他最擅长的得分方式。
“滚开！”叶锋冲巴恩斯吼道，只带了一步就拿起了篮球，全速冲向篮下。
湖人的队友们一看他这架势，都瞪圆了眼睛。只要叶锋冲起来，就是人挡杀人，佛挡杀佛，如果不躲开，很有可能造成叶锋带球撞人，但那基本是拿命去防守……
巴恩斯打了四个赛季经验丰富，他可不想季前赛就和人玩命，赶紧闪出了位置。
叶锋侧飞起而起，和巴恩斯擦身而过，一记势大力沉的“战斧”，砰的一声，将球重重的砸进了篮筐里。19比21。
全场沸腾了，球迷们可不管巴恩斯防守放水，只知道这球扣的漂亮。
湖人队友们都兴奋的在场边挥舞着毛巾，回防时，法玛尔也和叶锋拍了一下手，这一球很提士气。
勇士队主教练老尼尔森眼前一亮，他觉得叶锋的条件很适合打炮轰战术，如果湖人不和他签约，就把他弄到勇士来，不过看这两个回合的表现，似乎湖人没有不签他的理由。
史密斯叫道：“我的上帝，早就听说他的身体素质很好，没想到是这种野兽派，易建联、孙悦的体侧数据也很惊人，中国人的身体素质似乎普遍提高了啊。”
巴克利笑道：“怪不得外号饿狼，这小子够狠的。”
勇士进攻，赖特又出来掩护，持球进攻的还是埃利斯，挡拆后叶锋再次和他对位。埃利斯带球突破，吸引了叶锋的重心向后移动后，急停跳投出手，叶锋没有封盖到，但球投偏了，埃利斯的投篮并不是很稳定，球弹的很远，往弱侧跑位的赖特场臂捞了前场篮板。他希望能在NBA第一个赛季就证明自己的价值，想打的强硬一些，一步拔起来就要双手扣篮，换防后法玛尔是没法阻止他的。
眼看他就要将球摁进篮筐，叶锋从侧面防上来了。全力起跳，同样是用双手，狠狠的按在了篮球上。

两人的身体在空中相撞，赖特身高占优，可瘦的像竹竿一样，一碰就失去了平衡，被叶锋连人带球一起盖倒在地。裁判的哨声响了。
见叶锋稳稳的落地，球馆内又爆出一阵惊呼，他上场后立即抢了全场球员的风头，这球防的太猛了，赖特摔了个七荤八素，躺了一会儿才起来。站起来也没敢说什么，谁看了都觉的他被叶锋欺负了。
赖特被送上了罚球线，两罚一中，叶锋拿下了后场篮板球。
接下来的比赛，叶锋不会进攻的缺陷开始显露，挡拆后高位试投了两次，全部偏出。不过他在防守中的作用还是非常明显，尤其对禁区的保护，他的一次次补防让勇士外线乱了阵脚。埃利斯是个很有冲击力的球员，但和科比相比，他还是嫩一些，被防下几次后，他越来越急躁，几次出手时机选择的都不好。在叶锋的协防下连续四次进攻未果，好不容易突到篮下一次，还挨了拜纳姆的大帽。赖特被叶锋狠狠的犯规后，心态也产生了变化，更多是在高位徘徊，不敢再冲内线扣篮了。他可不想常规赛还没开打就进伤病名单。
第二节还剩3分钟的时候，叶锋领到了个人本场第四次犯规，杰克逊才将他换下。之后他一直坐在板凳上。他还没打够，小声对布莱恩.肖说道：“布莱恩，为什么主教练不让我再上了，刚才我做的有什么不对吗？”
布兰恩.肖轻道：“你没发现主力们都坐在场下吗？你表现很好，已经不用再考察了。教练是不想把你的弱点全暴露给对方。”

Chapter Thirteen Fauvism
It was finally time to appear in the official competition. Looking at the sea of people in the audience, Ye Feng took a few deep breaths.
With so many people watching, if I don't perform well, maybe these people will post online saying that the Lakers shouldn't sign me, and I must prove with actions that I can play in the NBA. Just as Ye Feng was thinking about it, his back suddenly hurt and he was slapped hard.
Fisher saw something strange about him, so he slapped him and said loudly: "Don't be nervous! Recall what you have learned these days. Do what you did during training and do it now. You were guarding Kobe and Odom during training. Who are these people on the Warriors? You can guard them."
Fisher always took care of Ye Feng and said some words of encouragement. Ye Feng nodded gratefully and walked onto the court.
Both sides adjusted their lineups and replaced several substitutes. The Warriors replaced Brandon Wright at the power forward position. Wright is this year's rookie, selected with the eighth pick in the first round by the Bobcats. As soon as Ye Feng stood next to him, he felt that he was a freak. This guy's arms were too long!
Wright's face was expressionless, looking like a goose. He is 206cm tall and has a wingspan of 223cm, which is longer than Ye Feng's arm, but his weight is only 91 kilograms. The Bobcats used him as a bargaining chip to exchange for Richardson from the Warriors. The Warriors are very optimistic about his development potential.
Ye Feng mustered up all his strength. This was a good opportunity. He remembered that in his previous life, Wright was nothing special, just a parallel import. No one in the league knows this right now, and any win over Wright will definitely improve his rating.
When the Lakers attacked, Farmar dribbled the ball to the frontcourt, and Bynum moved to the high post to cover. His mid-range shots were more accurate than Ye Feng's, while Ye Feng ran to prepare for air cuts and scramble for offensive rebounds. Wright is also very fast, the most amazing among the big men, and he can keep up with Ye Feng.
As long as there is someone following Ye Feng, the defender will not pass the ball to him, and his singles ability is not worthy of trust at all.
Farmar made a sudden pass to Radmanovic at the edge of the three-second zone, who quickly transferred the ball to Vujacic on the bottom foot. Vujacic took the ball and shot a three-pointer, and the ball bounced out of the frame.
Wright's upper body strength is very poor. He can only bench press 84 kilograms twice. He was stuck behind Ye Feng. However, shooting guard Pietrus judged the position of the rebound very accurately and rushed to grab the rebound. Ye Feng hurried back to defend.
Speed ​​is the only magic weapon for the Warriors to win. Pietrus gets the rebound and passes forward to start a fast break, without waiting for the inside players to get into position. After Davis came off the court, Monta Ellis became the team's first main point of attack. The ball was passed to him. He took the ball and rushed towards the Lakers half, easily getting rid of Farmar.
Just when Ellis stopped to prepare for a jump shot, Ye Feng jumped up from behind and glided in the air to pounce. Ellis reacted quickly and changed the shot to a feint. He watched Ye Feng fly past him, but when he tried to shoot again, he had lost the chance. Farmar returned to defend.
Ye Feng was under the opponent's basket just now, but he returned to defense much faster than Bynum who ran first. He passed the half court in a few steps. The distance from takeoff to landing was enough to jump from the free throw line to the basket. This time, the defense was successful!
Someone noticed this, and Buckley was surprised: "Oh my God, how far did he just fly?"
Smith smiled and said: "It is indeed a terrifying quality."
Wright also ran to the basket, and Ye Feng stepped forward to defend him closely, keeping him out of the three-second zone. Ellis controlled the ball and passed it to Barnes on the outside. He went out to find a cover. Wright stepped forward to help Ellis get the ball. After Ye Feng changed defense, he faced Ellis again.
Ellis was selected by the Golden State Warriors with the 40th overall pick in the second round of 2005. He is one of the last high school students in the NBA. His breakthrough speed is astonishing, he can shuttle freely in the penalty area where there are many people, and he can score like chopping melons and vegetables. arriveThis season, he has begun to show his strength.
Few inside players can keep up with his speed after the pick-and-roll switch, but Ye Feng is an exception. He bypassed Wright and blocked Ellis' breakthrough route, preventing him from successfully rushing into the three-second zone.
It’s this guy again, so fast! Ellis shook his left shoulder slightly and quickly changed direction to the right with the ball. Ye Feng did not take the fake move and blocked his path again. He had been passed by Kobe countless times with this kind of change of direction fake move, and he already had experience in defending. He not only observed the movement of his shoulders, but also used the corner of his eye to pay attention to which leg Ellis was going to take.
Ellis won the Most Improved Player Award last season, and his confidence has already been demonstrated. How could he endure being guarded by a rugby player? He immediately stepped back and dribbled the ball, with his right foot as the axis, and his right hand made a dribbling movement behind his back. Halfway through, he handed the ball to his left hand for dribbling, and then dribbled the ball back to his right hand with his left hand.
Ye Feng was stunned by stepping down twice in a row. His body moved slightly to the right. Ellis immediately took a big step and broke through from Ye Feng's left side.
Ye Feng knew he was going to get passed as soon as he made a fake move. Under the guidance of Brian Xiao, he had already figured out how to remedy the situation. He made the mistake without any pause, turning from the right side to pursue Ellis for a layup.
When Ellis was holding the ball in his right hand and preparing for a layup, he caught a glimpse of Ye Feng who jumped up to block the shot in advance. He was not a vegetarian, so he knew he didn't throw it away. After jumping up, he retracted his right hand in the air and made a pull-bar motion before going up for a layup, trying to avoid Ye Feng's block.
Ellis miscalculated, and Ye Feng seemed to be stuck in the air. He opened his right hand and disrupted his shooting rhythm. He sent the ball away from Ye Feng with a low hand, and it circled around the basket and missed. Walton got the rebound.
After Ye Feng landed, he immediately rushed towards the Warriors half court and directly participated in the fast break.
Is this guy still human? Wright is the fastest among the Warriors' interior players, but he is left behind by Ye Feng. Farmar's ball went straight into Ye Feng's hands. Ye Feng took the ball in the middle, and the man defending in front of him was Barnes.
Ye Feng is still terrible at dribbling. He has no confidence in anyone, and once he brings the ball, his speed advantage cannot be used. During normal extra practice, in addition to dribbling and shooting, he practices most often dunking, which is his best way to score.
"Get out of here!" Ye Feng yelled at Barnes. He picked up the basketball with just one step and rushed towards the basket at full speed.
When the Lakers teammates saw his posture, their eyes widened. As long as Ye Feng charges, he will kill people and kill people. If he doesn't dodge, it is very likely that Ye Feng will hit someone with the ball, but that is basically defending with his life...
Barnes has played four seasons and has rich experience. He doesn't want to risk his life with others in the preseason and quickly vacates his position.
Ye Feng flew up sideways, passed by Barnes, and hit the ball hard into the basket with a powerful and heavy "Tomahawk". 19 to 21.
The whole court was in a frenzy. The fans didn't care about Barnes' defense, they only knew that the ball was a beautiful dunk.
The Lakers teammates were all excitedly waving towels on the sidelines. When returning to defense, Farmar also clapped hands with Ye Feng. This goal boosted morale.
Warriors head coach Nelson's eyes lit up. He felt that Ye Feng's conditions were very suitable for bombardment tactics. If the Lakers didn't sign him, they would bring him to the Warriors. However, judging from his performance in these two rounds, it seemed that the Lakers had no reason not to sign him.
Smith exclaimed: "My God, I've heard that his physical fitness is very good. I didn't expect him to be such a beast. The body statistics of Yi Jianlian and Sun Yue are also amazing. The physical fitness of Chinese people seems to have generally improved."
Buckley smiled and said: "No wonder he is nicknamed Hungry Wolf, this kid is quite ruthless."
The Warriors attacked, and Wright came out to cover again. Ellis was still the one attacking with the ball. After the pick-and-roll, Ye FengFace him again. Ellis broke through with the ball, attracted Ye Feng's center of gravity to move backward, and made a jump shot. Ye Feng did not block the shot, but the ball missed. Ellis's shot was not very stable, and the ball bounced very far. Wright, who ran to the weak side, grabbed the offensive rebound with his arm. He hopes to prove his worth in his first season in the NBA. He wants to play tougher and dunk with both hands in one step. Farmar cannot stop him after switching defenses.
Just as he was about to put the ball into the basket, Ye Feng defended him from the side. He took off with all his strength and pressed hard on the basketball with both hands.
The two bodies collided in the air. Wright had the advantage in height, but he was as thin as a bamboo pole. He lost his balance at the first touch and was covered by Ye Feng while dribbling the ball and fell to the ground. The referee's whistle sounded.
Seeing Ye Feng landing firmly, another burst of exclamations erupted in the arena. He immediately stole the limelight from all the players after he came on the court. The ball was defended so hard that Wright fell to pieces and lay down for a while before getting up. He didn't dare to say anything when he stood up. Everyone who looked at him felt that he was being bullied by Ye Feng.
Wright was sent to the free throw line and made one of two free throws. Ye Feng got the backcourt rebound.
In the next game, Ye Feng's shortcomings of not being able to attack began to show up. After the pick-and-roll, he tried two high-post shots, both of which missed. However, his role in defense is still very obvious, especially in protecting the penalty area. His repeated defenses disrupted the Warriors' position on the outside. Ellis is a very impactful player, but compared with Kobe, he is still a little greener. After being guarded a few times, he became more and more impatient, and his timing of several shots was not chosen well. With Ye Feng's assistance, he failed to attack four times in a row. He finally got to the basket once and was blocked by Bynum. After Wright was severely fouled by Ye Feng, his mentality also changed. He was more hovering in the high position and no longer dared to rush inside for dunks. He doesn't want to be on the injured list before the regular season starts.
With 3 minutes left in the second quarter, Ye Feng received his fourth foul of the game before Jackson replaced him. He remained on the bench after that. Before he had played enough, he whispered to Brian Xiao: "Brian, why doesn't the head coach let me play again? Is there anything wrong with what I did just now?"
Brian Xiao Qing said: "Didn't you notice that the main players were all sitting off the court? You performed very well and there is no need for further inspection. The coach does not want to expose all your weaknesses to the other party."
